name: Wo Yu Mowang de Qinmi Ailian
source:
Growing up in a quite wealthy family with a lovely family, I thought that everything would be all right as it is now.
But then the accident happened...

"It was so painful, so hopeless, I couldn't breathe, my heart felt like it was going to explode, I didn't want to hear anything..."

"Nothing matters anymore."

An accident took away my family, my life, my everything, all that remains is the eyes that can no longer have a clear view of the world, I was abandoned by the world, I have no value of existence.

But I met you, the one who saved me, you are my only light, pulling my hand to go forward.

Thus, I lived together with the demon king of the other world, getting to know each other in life and having an adventure together that I had never thought of in my life.

But the more I try to understand you, the more I feel that you are suffering more than I thought.
You are also an abandoned person.
The burden of the country, the distrust of the people, and the hunt of the heroes, all that you have endured is not for one person to bear.

Flan, this time, it's my turn to save you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1988090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我在一个颇为富裕、充满关爱的家庭中长大，原以为一切都会像现在这样顺遂下去。
然而，那场事故却突然降临……

“好痛苦，好绝望，喘不上气，心脏快要炸裂了，什么都不想听……”

“已经什么都无所谓了。”

一场意外夺走了我的家人、我的人生与我的一切，唯独留下一双再也看不清世界的眼睛。我被这个世界抛弃，彻底失去了存在的价值。

但我遇见了拯救我的你。你是我唯一的光，牵起我的手带我一同前行。

就这样，我与异世界的魔王共同生活，在日常中彼此了解，并携手踏上了一段我这辈子从未想过的冒险。

然而越是了解你，我便越是发觉你所承受的痛苦远超我的想象。
你同样也是一个被抛弃的人。
背负国家的重担、遭受子民的不信任、面临勇者的追杀——你所忍受的这一切，绝非一个人所能独自承担。

芙兰，这一次，轮到我来拯救你了。

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1988090/]Steam[/url]]
